bash -lc cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
base = open('my_warrior.red').read()
# strip any previous pad lines (start with 'pd')
for P in [0,4,8,12,16,20,24,28]:
    pads = ''.join(f"pd{i}    dat     0, 0\n" for i in range(P))
    # insert pads right after the org line
    lines = base.split('\n')
    out = []
    for ln in lines:
        out.append(ln)
        if ln.strip().startswith('org'):
            out.append(pads.rstrip())
    open(f'exp/pad/p{P}.red','w').write('\n'.join(out))
print('done')
EOF
